label: Default impurity waiver policy (starter)
description: Explicit, time-bounded impurity waivers used by reproducibility checks and adapter lanes. Default deny.

justification.reason: Ports adapter lane still contains non-deterministic build systems; allow classification as known impurity while migration/patching proceeds.
Some firmware/microcode payloads are hardware/availability constrained; track explicitly and require firmware inventory evidence.

notes: Keep waivers narrow; extensions and scope broadenings should be treated as posture drift.
Prefer fixing determinism upstream over adding waivers.
